lines.ja: クイズの達人へようこそ！

lines.en: Today's theme is...

lines.ja: キミは正しいロゴを見破れるかな？
lines.en: Can you spot the correct logo?

lines.en: There are 30 questions in total!

lines.en: Five types of sports? The world's five continents? Or five tournament rules?
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: キミは何問正解できたかな？

lines.en: Let us know in the comments!

lines.en: If you got 21 or more right...
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.en: You're a logo master!

lines.en: Congratulations!
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: 次回のクイズもお楽しみに！
lines.en: Look forward to the next quiz!
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: チャンネル登録を忘れないでね！
lines.en: Don't forget to subscribe to the channel!

lines.ja: またキミのチャレンジを待ってるよ！
